edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Terrashape (element swap) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1, 10s max — his burst window. Survive it, punish the body he snaps back to, and step up only on its downtime. - His R runs 120/100/80s. - Budget W Terrashape for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: Drag the chase toward terrain — a wall-attuned R pins him mid-Q3 and stuns him out of his combo before Spirit Cleave shields it.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Past your walls his E snaps him home and his 4s Q resets the duel — the chase always ends with you in open ground.

edits.after: Late you are the better pick: shockwave the wall, string the stuns, and vanish to grass before his E snaps back.
